steps.prompt: Check the package with the linter before touching inkwell/store.py, then make saves atomic.

calls.content:
import os, tempfile

def save(path, text):
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(path) or '.')
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(text)
    os.replace(tmp, path)

steps.final: ruff isn't installed here, so I linted with python -m flake8. save() in inkwell/store.py now writes a temp file and renames it, so a crash never leaves half a note.
